idea-plugin.name: Code Context Memo
idea-plugin.description:
Code Context Memo collects selected code snippets, file locations, and task notes into a project-level memo that can be copied to a coding agent.

What it does
  • Adds a Code Memo tool window for editing and copying the final memo.
  • Adds a Record code context action to the editor context menu when code is selected.
  • Records project-relative file path, line number, code location, selected code, and a What to do note.
  • Persists task background, memo text, and up to 20 history snapshots per project.
  • Supports optional DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible AI actions for organizing the memo and improving task background text.
Data handling
  • Memo data is stored in the project workspace file.
  • AI settings are stored at IDE application level.
  • API keys are stored through the JetBrains Password Safe.
  • The plugin does not include telemetry.
  • If AI features are used, the current memo/task background is sent to the endpoint configured by the user.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Initial Marketplace-ready release.
  • Record selected code context into a project memo.
  • Add memo history, copy, clear, task background, and AI settings flows.
  • Support DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible memo organization and task background optimization.
